A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the energy consumption of C-RAN in the morning is higher than the other two time periods, and it decreases with the increasing QoS.
the daily user behaviour has a great influence on the energy consumption of C-RAN, which is more obvious in the peak hours.
the energy consumption of C-RAN in a 24-hour cycle is not a constant value.

the C-RAN architecture with a 10G front-haul has a significant advantage over the traditional network architecture.
the C-RAN architecture can reduce the OPEX of operators significantly, especially in the scenario of low user demands.
